create_readout_block: create a ReadoutBlock instance with global, GNN, and regularization config objects
run_forward_readout: run the ReadoutBlock forward pass with data, node features, and edge features tensors
build_global_readout: build a global readout FFN with configurable hidden size, activation, and dropout
build_node_readout: build a node readout FFN with residual connection and pre-normalization layer
build_edge_readout: build an edge readout FFN for direct force regression with normalization
